head.title: Slow Query E2E
head.teaser: A minimal game for observing a long-running query

select-scene.sql-solution: WITH RECURSIVE counter(value) AS ( SELECT 0 UNION ALL SELECT value + 1 FROM counter WHERE value < 2000000 ) SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(value) >= 0 THEN 'completed' END AS status FROM counter
